desc:
🏝 Redline Island is a game about driving around a small Island based in the Caribbean atmosphere, meeting new friends, and roleplaying together! Choose from a massive variety of all types of vehicles, meet new people, and explore around the towns! 

🖌 Be able to customize your car to your liking with paint, wheels, suspension, plates, parts and so much more! 

💼 Roleplay (RP) with interactive jobs, enjoy driving your car around the town, claim a house and create realistic town roleplay with others!

Codes: ALWAYSLATE!, HALLOWEEN!, REVAMPSOON!

⚙️Instructions:
For PC,
S+F To start vehicle E to gear up Q to gear down P for parking break
For Console,
L2 + O/B To start vehicle
R1/RB to gear up, L1/LB to gear down
Square or X for parking brake
Mobile players must release the parking brake in order to drive!

⚠️ Running into problems? Please report them on our Roblox Community!
